title: finding(tooling): 132 of the 649 generated keys take their namespace from the hand-kept INDIRECT_REGISTRATIONS table, not from the call — the objectui#9641 phantom reached by a second route
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`, R1, as the carrier the objectui#9641 implementer asked for on hand-back (it cannot `POST /issues` itself). ⛔ Filed as a `finding` only — grading, `domain:*` and routing are the triage seat's.

## The shape

`scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` derives the registry key universe that `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts` is generated from. For most keys it reads the namespace **out of the registration call**. For a set of them it does not: it reads the namespace out of a **hand-kept table**, `INDIRECT_REGISTRATIONS`.

Re-read by this seat at objectui#9641's landing head `b9603eba96e0793a00f1187f083eaffc1945eb7e`:

- `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs:489` — `export const INDIRECT_REGISTRATIONS = [`
- `:1387` — `const indirect = options.indirectRegistrations ?? INDIRECT_REGISTRATIONS;` ⇒ the table is the default the derivation runs on
- `:119` — the derivation's own docblock says such registrations are declared 「explicitly in `INDIRECT_REGISTRATIONS` with the collection it reads」
- `scripts/__tests__/check-prompt-component-keys.test.ts:45` imports it alongside `deriveRegistryKeys`, and `:259` / `:264` read it

⇒ for those keys the namespace in the generated list is **not derived from the code that registers them**. It is copied from a list a human maintains beside it.

## Why that is the objectui#9641 family, by a different route

objectui#9641 is: *the derivation cannot resolve a namespace passed by spread, so real runtime keys go missing from the generated list, silently.* This is the mirror image on the same instrument — **a namespace edit at one of these call sites does not reach the generated list at all**, because the list is not reading that call site for the namespace. The failure is the same class (a generated universe that silently disagrees with the runtime) reached by a second route, and it is a **class (c)** trap: an author changes a registration's namespace, the code is correct, and `objectui check` keeps validating against the old one.

⚠️ **The count is ATTRIBUTED, ⛔ not re-derived by this seat.** The objectui#9641 implementer reports **132** of the 649 keys taking this route (its counters: `callSites 238, resolved 233, open 2, indirect 132, metaViaReference 5`). Re-deriving it requires running `deriveRegistryKeys`, which needs an installed workspace; the shared checkout has none, and a probe needing a resolved pin returns a dead-instrument zero there — ⛔ so that zero was not read and no number of this seat's own is offered. **Re-measure before acting.**

What this seat did re-derive, from the generated file directly: the list holds **644** entries at merge-base `72f55c9ec` and **649** at `b9603eba9`, and the five namespaced page keys (`ui:page` / `ui:app` / `ui:utility` / `ui:home` / `ui:record`) read **1 each** at the head and **0** at the merge-base, with an absent-token control at **0**. That is the objectui#9641 fix delivered; it is ⛔ not a measurement of this card's 132.

## ⚠️ What this card does NOT claim

- ⛔ It does **not** say the table is wrong today. Whether any entry currently disagrees with its call site is **NOT MEASURED**.
- ⛔ It does **not** propose the repair. Deriving the namespace from the call for these forms is what objectui#9641 spent four rounds discovering is hard, and its ruling (batch #150 item 2, letter B) explicitly capped that direction: 「a regex approximation has no finishing line」. A repair round here should read that ruling **first**, and should expect the honest end state to be a **declaration** rather than a closed shape.
- ⛔ It does **not** claim a live consumer is affected. objectui#9641's live tree reads **0 findings**; like that card, this is a latent trap, not an incident.

## Dedup terms

`indirect registration table` · `INDIRECT_REGISTRATIONS` · `namespace phantom` · `hand-kept collection` · `deriveRegistryKeys`

## Provenance

Raised as a non-blocking class (c) observation by objectui#9641's round-3 at-tier contract review, which called it 「worth its own card」, and handed back again by that card's closing-round implementer with an explicit request for a carrier. The four line-addressed readings above were taken by this seat at the landing head; the 132 figure is attributed and ⛔ carries no reading of this seat's own.
